primary_objective: Land the lander on the landing pad at (0,0) as fast as possible with minimal fuel consumption.
objective_decomposition: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the landing pad from above.
Phase 2: Descend with controlled vertical speed while maintaining horizontal alignment.
Phase 3: Final touchdown with minimal vertical velocity and upright orientation.
behavior_trajectory_alignment: Phase 1: Stabilize and approach the landing pad from above.
Phase 2: Descend with controlled vertical speed while maintaining horizontal alignment.
Phase 3: Final touchdown with minimal vertical velocity and upright orientation.
metric_priority: Episodic return (cumulative reward) averaged over many episodes.
primary_selection_metric: Episodic return (cumulative reward) averaged over many episodes.
success_criteria: Both legs in contact with ground (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1).
Lander is awake and not crashed.
failure_modes: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine, never landing.
Landing far from pad but still upright (no crash) – satisfies soft landing but misses primary objective.
Excessive use of orientation engines causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing with high vertical velocity but legs contact first – may be scored as success but is unsafe.
bad_local_optima: Hovering indefinitely at high altitude using main engine, never landing.
Landing far from pad but still upright (no crash) – satisfies soft landing but misses primary objective.
Excessive use of orientation engines causing oscillation or wasted fuel.
Landing with high vertical velocity but legs contact first – may be scored as success but is unsafe.
reward_generator_constraints: Reward must be a scalar float returned by compute_reward.
Must encourage landing on pad (x=0,y=0) with low speed and upright orientation.
Should penalize crashes and out-of-bounds heavily.
Should provide shaping signals (e.g., distance decrease, velocity reduction) to guide learning.
Fuel penalty should be mild to avoid discouraging necessary engine use.
Do not reward hovering indefinitely; encourage timely landing.
Must not require external libraries beyond standard Python and gym.
